summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing proactive steps to investigate potential manipulation of its common shares. The company, issuer of the shares, states it has observed unusual trading patterns, particularly around earnings releases, and plans to retain forensic investigators. No specific terms, stakes, prices, premiums, or dates are stated. The board supports the investigation, and findings will be provided to regulators. There are no deal mechanics or structural notes. This is not a special situation but a routine announcement regarding trading concerns; no corporate transaction or change is involved.
